info.title: Revition CLI API
info.description: The CLI-facing subset of the Revition platform API (REVITION-CLI-PLAN T1.2.5).

bearer.description: A CLI session (rvs_...) or a personal access token (rvt_...). The two session-exchange routes take the Revition CLI's own Auth0 access token instead.

delete.description: Requires the CLI scope cli:write; RBAC and data-level checks then apply as on the web.
